evidence.instructions: A session edited these files and claimed the work is done. What would actually prove it works?

criteria.type_check: Types, a rename, or a signature changed, and nothing runtime did
criteria.unit_test: Pure logic changed and a test can assert the literal result
criteria.browser_screenshot: A visible surface changed and one frame shows it
criteria.recording: A sequence or timing changed and one frame cannot show it
criteria.none: Nothing a check exercises changed. Docs, comments, config or dead code
